title: Iceberg Slim and the pimps he knew in Washington
summary: He recalls meeting a golden-tongued pimp called Iceberg Slim in Washington, D.C., and the polite terms for prostitutes.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: with the golden tongue. He could talk a woman and make her stand up in the church and take her clothes off. That's the kind of guy he was.

Yeah, well, see, that's why they used to call him Tough Titty. His real name was Eddie something, but they called him Iceberg Slim. The world's greatest black pimp. Now, let me tell you a story about pimps.

This was in Washington, D.C., where I met him, but he was mostly around Chicago and Ohio and Cleveland where he had all of his prostitutes. They called them whores at that time, or prostitutes, or ladies. Ladies of the evening. Ladies of the evening.
